name: mish.music
description: A starship-style now-playing card for the sidebar. Shows and controls what's playing in Music.app or in Safari (YouTube, SoundCloud, JioSaavn...), with seek, shuffle and repeat, and a volume bar that is your Mac's system volume. Two looks you can switch between: a card with cover art, or a terminal you can type commands into. Nearly everything about how it looks is a setting: palette presets, colours, pill shape, border, size, cover art, bars, motion and font.
author: mishti
